title: Unit 6 — GP-06: Cooling-System Comparison
description: Follow the guided MATLAB code-along to compare two cooling configurations in a figure with two stacked panels. Calculate and plot their temperature difference, add labels and a legend, then interpret the results and export your figure for Canvas.
note: All data are embedded in the starter. The data are synthetic and 70 C is an exercise limit. Run Tests provides feedback and never submits to Canvas.
